inputs.title: The Crab's filaments, 416,573 velocity components of the 3D map of Martin, Milisavljevic & Drissen (2021) as places and speeds
inputs.acquisition: Built from the authors' files 3dmap_XYZflux.fits, 3dmap_XYZvel.fits and m1.deep_frame.fits by the generator (`node packages/bake/authoring/m1/filament-speeds.mts src/objects/m1-layers 2000.3`), which downloads them at commit af491d4, places each point through the frame's fit to Gaia DR3 and moves it to the picture's date. Restored from the source cache; not tracked.
